title: Beatrice d'Aragona to Ippolito d'Este, Naples, 29 May 1505 (DECODE R1154): not a cipher

steps.what: Extracted five exact dates, recipients and shelfmarks from cached DECODE metadata; web reader could not open live DECODE page.
Used existing user-authorized DECODE cookie to acquire all 18 images. R1143 has repeated photographs with decipherment slips moved.
R1154 is plain Italian, explicitly says per non havere cifra; manuscript dates it quingentesimo quinto (1505), agreeing with Berzeviczy no. CCCII.
Entry split from beatrice1482 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R1154 is not a cipher and gets its own not-applicable entry.

outcome.method_basis: The letter is plain Italian chancery writing; it says it has no cipher, and Berzeviczy (1914) no. CCCII prints it.
outcome.notes: Date corrected 1504 -> 1505 from the dating clause (M° quingentesimo quinto), the docket and the photograph label. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from beatrice1482.

credits.note: 1914 edition no. CCCII prints the letter
